patterns.note: Full-width, dark background sections with content centered horizontally, often using a grid for multiple items (speakers, images).
Extremely large, bold, all-caps sans-serif headings create strong visual hierarchy and impact, especially in the hero and section titles.
A high-contrast black and white theme with minimal, dynamic color accents primarily in the hero background, which changes on scroll.
The hero section features a background color transition and content fade-out on scroll, while subsequent content sections reveal with a subtle fade-up effect.
Content is organized into distinct, full-width sections introduced by large, all-caps headings, each with a clear purpose (speakers, venue, vibes).

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header that remains visible throughout the scroll, providing persistent navigation and a call-to-action.
The hero section features a dynamic background that transitions between different color gradients as the user scrolls, likely using a canvas animation for a smooth, continuous effect.

Main content sections are revealed with a subtle, staggered fade-up or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement and guiding the user's eye, likely implemented with CSS keyframes.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, all-caps sans-serif headings (hero text is massive, ~6x body) with smaller, all-caps labels and standard body text, creating high contrast in size and weight.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle; elements like buttons and speaker cards have very slightly rounded corners, almost sharp.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, especially in the hero and between major content sections, creating a sense of spaciousness, while content within grids (speakers, images) is more dense.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its dramatic, full-screen hero background that dynamically transitions colors on scroll, combined with the impactful, oversized typography. This creates a highly immersive and visually engaging initial experience that sets it apart from typical event pages.
